description: CSV derivative deposit for the accompanying study.
CamCAN derivatives only; seven models, eleven frozen representations and 25 retained adapted runs.
No raw MRI, true ages, sex, error/BAG columns, source demographics or filesystem paths.
Not a complete reproduction dataset; excludes other cohorts, processed images and model weights.
Embeddings checked against sidecars; test predictions against receipts; validation predictions checked for identity, split and finiteness, with source digests recorded.
Original CamCAN study IDs retained for linkage; these are not newly anonymised identifiers.
